limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Firefly-AST $1.3B deal is a discrete verified defense order moving equity; DoW $75M loan commitment is authoritative; Canada's $22B defense/Ukraine boost, Syria-Saudi $403M defense deal with Saudi military aid to Houthi fight, Norway-US defense accord, Turkey-Saudi Mecca pact, Japan defense spending surge and hypersonic race are material defense-order signals.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: US October jobs surge (165k, 4.1% unemployment) is the top macro print; Canada's unemployment rise to 6.7% is a verified divergence; Vietnam manufacturing slowdown, BoE governor on EU ties, Kenya corruption drag, Indonesia GDP weaknesses, Brazil debt near 83% GDP and US layoff-recession fears are material growth signals.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Oil price surge on tanker attacks is the dominant global macro event; midterm-driven hopes of more Mideast crude and pump-price moves are macro-relevant; US-Venezuela crude import high, Eni-Libya $8B gas deal, Cuba oil sanctions, Mauritania PSCs and bank forecast revisions are verified supply-side changes.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: AI credit stress (CoreWeave 16% yield, CDS warning on AI downgrades, SoftBank CDS 4-year high, debt-funded data centers) is the strongest systemic signal; imminent default-deadline loan talks, Paraguay Ueno insolvency, Sri Lanka $1bn outflow probe, Nigerian loan defaults and Kuwait housing-loan rules are verified credit events.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Medicare's 340B cuts and site-neutral payment expansion plus final 2027 physician fee cuts are large verified payment changes affecting providers; Minnesota Medicaid work-requirement lawsuit, post-midterm Medicaid-cut bets lifting hospital stocks, FDA Zolgensma malignancy probe, and FDA approval of amivantamab for HNSCC are discrete policy/regulatory events.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: New US strike on Iran and Iran-war election fallout are verified state changes with global market transmission (oil, rates); Russia's Kyiv missile strike and refinery attacks are material; Iran sanctions tighten; tanker attacks/Hormuz risk drive oil; NATO/Ukraine diplomacy and Abyei drone strikes round out top global-signal events.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: BoE's first rate hike since 2023 on Iran-war inflation is a major policy change; Fed's Daly and Williams signaling higher-for-longer and a likely December hike are material; Banxico cut with rising inflation forecasts, euro-area PPI, BoC 2% framework renewal, Norges hold and China's emergency yuan rule are verified central-bank actions.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Democrats retaking Congress with Iran-war blame is the dominant political shock driving markets; House GOP shutdown-avoidance plan, Nigeria disputed election result, Utah flood emergency, federal suit over Alaska Senate certification, Israel coalition formation and wildfire policy deaths are verified political/social developments with transmission potential.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Gold holding $4,000 support amid hot jobs/inflation risk is the key macro price event; post-midterm gold/silver rally and WGC bottom call are verified market moves; Bangkok rebound volatility, Indian gold-loan surge, NSE gold-backed EGR launch, Dhanteras physical demand and Bolivia's silver/gold export surge are distinct corroborated market events.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: OpenAI reaffirming capex despite election backlash and Nvidia chips piling up in Hong Kong on China import hold are discrete, corroborated business events; data-center election backlash with Nasdaq drop, Google's Wyoming site acquisition, PPL's first PA data-center deal, AMD data-center sales doubling, Malaysia factory, and debt-funded data-center bond stress are material global AI-infrastructure signals.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Supreme Court rejecting Trump's global tariffs is the largest discrete trade policy shock; Canada's China EV tariff and steel/aluminum relief extend trade war; China's five-year anti-dumping duties on US NPA, Vietnam tariff review, and post-midterm tariff escalation rhetoric (300%) plus China's zero-tariff Africa opening are material global trade events.
